name: Le Monde Béryl
band_note: shoe house, banded on shoe entry $180 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Italian-made women's slippers, flats, mules, pumps and boots, mostly $400–$1,100, sold through its own site, a New York store and department stores.
origin: Founded in 2016 by Lily Atherton Hanbury; Katya Shyfrin.

quote.q: The brand's continued evolution has developed around its central philosophy: Beauty in Movement.

opview: “The brand's continued evolution has developed around its central philosophy: Beauty in Movement.” — Le Monde Béryl (house), About, lemondeberyl.com

facts_read.source: brand site (about, Pre Fall 2026 campaign, NY store, terms); Companies House; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer index (2026-10-13 list); B Lab directory; GOTS database

Shoes.lp: Soft Venetian Slipper / Black Velvet (rubber sole)
Shoes.hp: Ballet Mary Jane / Black Mesh Crystal

doors.note: US: 1 own door, the flagship at 23 East 67th St (67th and Madison), New York 10065. It is the brand's only permanent store; the London (62 South Audley St, 4–13 June 2026) and Hydra (19–23 June 2026) pages are past dated pop-ups and are not counted. No stockist list. London label.
